scope: Subordinate to TAKY and Hide project canonical; no master promotion, main merge, visual approval, production release, or runtime mode implementation implied.
preserve: English learning semantics and approved home/environment source
free-choice TRACE/LINK/CORE/RECALL design; no false claim existing runtime implements mode switching
image and character Visual IDs immutable; no generated copy and no implicit asset promotion
no full-screen card dashboard; activity-local fragments/card layouts are allowed when pedagogically justified
tap-first mobile controls, optional drag with equivalent tap fallback, no forced full word typing
child is author; clues support rather than reveal; assisted success is not unassisted recall
source/OCR draft and verified learning content are separate; subject ranges and review schedules come from their owning layer

ownership.Hide: renders activities, attempts, minimal assistance, locally scoped observational evidence; no mastery or date allocation
ownership.LearningEngineCore: interprets concept/skill evidence, selects suitable review need and intensity; does not render Hide UI
ownership.Planner: dated allocation, target item/mission directive, carry-over
ownership.Ready: host/session/timer/return target and task-level result adapter
ownership.Snap: optional child-authored expression of acquired material, not Hide's primary learning UI
ownership.AssetOwner: existing approved Visual IDs; no regenerated paintings or persona replacement

LINK.intent: infer and verify relations, grouping and imagery

CORE.intent: reconstruct essential structure and apply understanding

RECALL.intent: retrieve without revealed answer, then correct/recover

modePolicy.legacyRuntimeStages: MEMORIZE/FIRST_FIND/MEANING/DOMAIN_EXTENSION/FINAL_SEEK/SEEK_AGAIN remain active in V2; no silent rename or equivalence
modePolicy.crossModeEvidence: use actual attempt/mode, not presumed stages

ENGLISH.prohibitedAssumption: all lexical tokens have historical etymology

HANJA.prohibitedAssumption: mnemonic picture is verified paleography or all components independently explain true etymology

FOCUS_CUE.appearance: single prominent live-text target anchored inside approved Hide study surface; no generic quiz dashboard

SOUND_KEY.appearance: short radio-like listening control with visible text alternative
SOUND_KEY.interaction: tap to hear, select matching meaning or reading

SOFT_TILE.appearance: lightweight translucent fragment; restrained border and clear selection state

CLUSTER_CHIP.appearance: central word/character and spaced small meaning chips; no auto extra study list
CLUSTER_CHIP.interaction: tap pair then connect; prior encounters prioritized

CONSTRAINED_GROUP.appearance: 2-4 visible destinations and 3-6 fragments; a compact work surface, not infinite whiteboard
CONSTRAINED_GROUP.interaction: tap item -> tap destination; drag optional; undo and reset

RELATION_SPINE.appearance: clean line/connector path for root-to-word, temporal, part-whole or cause-effect
RELATION_SPINE.interaction: select node pair and label relation; provenance check

COMPARISON_PAIR.appearance: two side-by-side or vertically comparable fragments with a single discriminating feature
COMPARISON_PAIR.interaction: select difference and support with context

SENTENCE_SLOT.appearance: short sentence and editable live DOM slot
SENTENCE_SLOT.interaction: tap candidate/voice where supported; answer must be uniquely justified

PART_ASSEMBLY.appearance: large focal item plus a limited tray of real fragments

IMAGE_MASK.appearance: approved or attributable contextual visual with selective overlays; live DOM question text
IMAGE_MASK.interaction: predict before reveal; uncover parts without auto-scoring visual exposure as recall

EXPANDABLE_FRAGMENT.appearance: compact one-line fragment, context/example on explicit request
EXPANDABLE_FRAGMENT.interaction: expansion is assistance evidence, not success

activitySelection.choose: match task and skill target to renderer; minimum visual complexity; preserve accessible equivalent interaction; no subject-wide rigid template
activitySelection.fallback: if evidence/visual unavailable use verified text and live-DOM interactions without invented source claims

contentTruth.rule: Historical roots, Hanja glyph origin and science/social facts need checked source; imagery or mnemonic explicitly labeled as mnemonic, never asserted historical source.
contentTruth.ocr: OCR_DRAFT!=CONFIRMED_UNIT; preserve source page/row/provider/confidence and explicit correction or acceptance

observationContract.rule: self-report/prediction/visual exposure/group motion is not a verified recall; successful assisted retry requires a later genuinely unassisted attempt before unassisted credit; preserve source/learner boundaries

implementationBindings.action: ADAPTER_DESIGN_ONLY; social/science require explicit subject-domain routing rather than ENGLISH fallback
READ_ONLY; do not make Ready semantic owner
PRESERVE; mode selector requires separate reviewed implementation
NO_OVERRIDE; original SHA + review gates remain

gates: no false runtime-active mode selector claim
no regeneration or replacement of approved Mossfall art, character IDs or user-invalid expedition reference
no OCR draft as confirmed learning source
rendered functionality is live DOM not baked image text
mode selection remains elective; no default success without answer
card permitted only when its comparison/grouping task needs it, not a home dashboard
tap fallback, reversible error, and reduced-motion and screen-reader alternatives
assisted success and unassisted recall separable
Learning Engine and Planner semantic owners preserved
visual 1:1 review, actual runtime implementation, real-device QA and release remain OPEN
